note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 24K-like luxury winter editorial leads the day: a woman models voluminous fur and shearling coats — white fur in the snow, a brown fuzzy coat, a black fur coat and a gray shearling jacket — across snowy alpine scenes and Parisian cafés, Hermès bags in hand. A 16K-like street-style carousel keeps it wearable: a voluminous brown faux-fur cropped jacket over light-wash wide-leg jeans with zebra-print pointed shoes. A 9.8K-like carousel posted this morning layers a cream oversized turtleneck poncho sweater over short brown shorts, while a 5.9K-like try-on reel cycles through fall outerwear in a wood-floored living room.
trends.title: Fur and shearling take over winter — alpine editorials, cropped faux-fur street style

trends.details: A 38K-like reel shows a man decking out his whole colorful home for Christmas early — the day's biggest home post. Handmade wins too: a 33K-like 'very merry whimsy homemade Christmas' reel cuts paper-chain garlands from plaid, star and polka-dot scrapbook paper and strings gold stars across a dark green bookshelf. A 20K-like reel decorates one large tree against black paneled doors, and a 10K-like 'I was only going to decorate a little' tour admits defeat — multiple trees, garland-wrapped chandeliers, a light-up village on the mantel and dried-orange-slice garlands everywhere.
trends.title: Christmas decorating goes maximalist and handmade — full-house takeovers, paper-chain DIY

trends.details: Frosty makeup freezes over. A 19K-like CHANEL Holiday 2025 film opens on a frozen lake and ice skater, then shows glossy pink lips, bright yellow winged liner and the collection laid out on sparkling snow. An 18K-like 'alternative winter makeup' tutorial builds a dramatic smoky eye with dark gray, silver and glitter reds. A 16K-like '$9 must have for frosty makeup season' reel dabs one shimmery stick on lips, cheekbones and eyelids for a dewy icy finish. A 4.7K-like transformation pairs icy blue-white shadow with heavy pink blush and glossy pink lips, while a 4.3K-like 'pale girl makeup' tutorial embraces fair skin with cool lavender-toned eyes, rosy cheeks and gloss.
trends.title: 'Frosty' makeup freezes over — icy eyes, shimmer sticks, Chanel's snowy holiday campaign
